name: synaptic_flux_kinesis
label: Synaptic Flux Kinesis
poeticVision: The ground beneath your feet shifts not due to the world, but due to your own mind. Every jump is a battle against forgetting, every dash a desperate reassertion of who you once were. You are not just running from the Silence; you are running from the dissolution of your very motor functions, your ability to move, to exist. The instability in your steps is the echo of a forgotten name, the faltering leap a fragment of a lost skill.
usage:
Attach this script to a CharacterBody3D node representing Lyra. Ensure your project's Input Map (Project Settings -> Input Map) has the following actions configured:
- "move_left" (e.g., A key)
- "move_right" (e.g., D key)
- "move_forward" (e.g., W key)
- "move_backward" (e.g., S key)
- "jump" (e.g., Spacebar)

The `memory_integrity` property can be modified externally by other game systems (e.g., Silence attacks, environmental hazards) using the `take_memory_damage(amount)` and `recover_memory_shard(amount, temporary_boost)` methods. For example, calling `player_node.take_memory_damage(0.1)` will reduce Lyra's memory by 10%, immediately degrading her movement. Calling `player_node.recover_memory_shard(0.05, true)` will restore 5% memory and grant a temporary movement boost.

parameters.name: base_speed
parameters.description: The character's base movement speed when memory integrity is full.

parameters.name: base_jump_velocity
parameters.description: The character's base jump velocity when memory integrity is full.

parameters.name: base_gravity_scale
parameters.description: A multiplier for the project's default 3D gravity. Affects how quickly the character falls.

parameters.name: base_friction
parameters.description: Determines how quickly the character's horizontal velocity decays when no input is given. Lower values make movement more slippery.

parameters.name: memory_integrity
parameters.description: The current state of Lyra's memory, ranging from 0.0 (fully degraded) to 1.0 (full memory). Directly impacts movement parameters.

parameters.name: integrity_degradation_factor
parameters.description: Controls the maximum impact of memory degradation. A value of 0.5 means at 0.0 memory integrity, speed, jump, and friction will be 50% of their base values, and gravity will be 25% higher.

parameters.name: memory_shard_boost_strength
parameters.description: The flat percentage bonus applied to movement parameters (speed, jump, friction) and reduction to gravity during a temporary memory shard boost.

parameters.name: memory_shard_boost_duration
parameters.description: The duration, in seconds, for which a temporary memory shard boost remains active.

verdict: In the dance of fading self, every faltering step becomes a desperate prayer against the encroaching void.
impact: This mechanic transforms basic locomotion into a constant, visceral struggle against the self, making every step a desperate act of remembrance and every jump a gamble against oblivion. It forces players to internalize Lyra's fading identity, creating a unique blend of physical challenge and emotional resonance where the very act of moving becomes a narrative device, directly embodying the game's core themes of self-loss and urgent survival.
